models.author: deepakku-redhat
models.name: Laguna-XS.2-FP8
models.description: Laguna XS.2-FP8 is a 33B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 3B activated parameters per token designed for agentic coding and long-horizon work on a local machine. It uses Sliding Window Attention with per-head gating in 30 out of 40 layers for fast inference and low KV cache requirements.
